epic.title: Phase 2: prompt management and LLM playground
epic.description: Add versioned prompts (labels with a protected `production`, diff, composition, per-version metrics), a public v2 prompt API, SDK `get_prompt` with stale-while-revalidate caching and generation linking, signed queued webhooks, encrypted LLM connections to six providers, and a streaming playground (open-from-trace, save-as-version, 4-way compare). Built on the Phase 1 stack in lite mode, with an offline test suite.

stories.title: Versioned prompts, labels and public API
stories.description: Data model, permissions, prompt logic (variables, composition, diff), the prompt service with audit and webhook events, and the public v2 prompt API.
acceptance: A prompt can be created and gets immutable, incrementing versions
Labels move with protected-label rules and an audit row
Composition resolves with a depth limit and cycle errors
GET /api/public/v2/prompts/{name} returns production by default

tasks.title: Skeleton: Phase 2 settings and runtime dependencies
tasks.description: Add encryption_key (comma-separated for rotation, required outside dev, ephemeral with a warning in dev), webhook_allow_private, llm_allow_private (default true), playground_rate and provider_timeout_seconds to Settings. Declare cryptography, anthropic, openai and google-genai as runtime dependencies with version constraints. Startup fails without a key outside dev.
acceptance: Settings exposes the new fields with the specified defaults
Startup fails outside dev when TRACELOOM_ENCRYPTION_KEY is unset
Dev generates an ephemeral key and logs a warning
Setup step installs the new dependencies
tasks.qa: none

tasks.title: Skeleton: Phase 2 tables, migration and permissions
tasks.description: Add the prompts, prompt_versions, prompt_labels, protected_labels, llm_connections, webhooks and webhook_deliveries models, api_keys.may_move_protected_labels and the observations (project_id, prompt_name, prompt_version) index in migration 0002. Seed the production protected label for existing and new projects. Add the new Perms to the permission matrix.
acceptance: Migration upgrades and downgrades on SQLite
Existing projects get a protected production label
A new project gets production protected
Perms match the spec matrix (Viewer read, Member write/run, Admin protected/connections/webhooks)
Phase 1 tests still pass

tasks.title: Prompt logic: variables, composition and diff
tasks.description: Pure modules for {{var}} find/compile (missing variables reported, unknown left as-is), @@@prompt:…@@@ parsing and recursive resolution (depth 5, cycle detection, dependency versions recorded, resolver injected), and escaped line/message/JSON-key diffs.
acceptance: compile substitutes known variables and reports missing ones without raising
A cycle raises an error naming the reference
Depth above 5 errors
Dependencies list the versions used
Chat prompt diff goes message by message
Config diff is key-level
Diff output carries no raw HTML
tasks.qa: none

tasks.title: Prompt service with audit and webhook events
tasks.description: create_version, move_label, get (label/version/latest/production-fallback), list (folders, search, tag/label filters, sort), delete and set_protected. Every write is project-scoped, permission-checked and audited. webhooks/events.py writes pending delivery rows for enabled webhooks; delivery itself comes later. Label moves never fail because of webhooks.
acceptance: Versions are immutable and increment from 1
latest cannot be set by hand
A Member moving production gets a permission error with no audit row or event
A Member moving staging succeeds and is audited
Prompt name validation matches FR-P1
Event rows are created for enabled webhooks only
tasks.qa: none

tasks.title: Public v2 prompt API
tasks.description: GET prompt (label/version/resolve, defaulting to production then latest), list, POST create version with labels, and PATCH versions/{n} newLabels, with Basic key auth and the Phase 1 error envelope. Keys may move protected labels only with the new flag, which is Admin-settable on key creation.
acceptance: GET without label or version returns production, else latest
A response has name, type, version, prompt, config, labels, tags, commit message and dependencies
A cyclic include returns 400 naming the cycle
A key without the flag cannot move production (403)
Names with / work URL-encoded
tasks.qa: With a project API key, curl POST /api/public/v2/prompts to create `support`, PATCH production onto v1, then GET /api/public/v2/prompts/support and check the JSON. Try the cycle case and a protected-label move with a plain key.

tasks.title: Prompt acceptance tests: journey, permissions, XSS and perf
tasks.description: End-to-end journey for AC-1..3, the Phase 2 permission sweep (Viewer 403 on every new write, Member 403 on Admin routes), XSS checks across prompts views (AC-9 for prompts), and the NFR-1 volume test.
acceptance: The journey runs examples/prompt_app.py and sees v2, then v3 within the TTL after the label move
The metrics tab shows 1 linked generation
A dialog handler fails the test if the XSS payload fires
The perf test meets NFR-1 on lite
tasks.qa: Run the new e2e tests. Then repeat the journey by hand: start the server, create support v1..v3, label production v2, run examples/prompt_app.py, move production to v3 in the browser and re-run.

stories.title: SDK prompt fetching, caching and linking
stories.description: Python SDK get_prompt with in-process cache and stale-while-revalidate, compile, fallback, async variants, generation linking and provider wrapper kwargs, plus seed models and docs.
acceptance: get_prompt returns Text/ChatPrompt and compile substitutes variables
After the TTL the stale value is returned and refreshed in the background
Generations link to the prompt, and fallback prompts are not linked
The Claude 5-family models are priced in the seed

tasks.title: SDK prompts: classes, cache and get_prompt
tasks.description: TextPrompt, ChatPrompt, PromptCache (TTL from TRACELOOM_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, stale-while-revalidate with one bounded daemon refresher per key), PromptNotFound, get_prompt/aget_prompt with retries, timeout and fallback. Uses the standard library and the existing HTTP client only.
acceptance: get_prompt then compile(name='Ann') substitutes variables for text and chat
With a 1 s TTL, the first call after expiry returns the old version immediately and the next returns the new one
A cold fetch failure uses the fallback with is_fallback=True, else raises PromptNotFound
Warm cache hits make no network call
A cold miss never blocks longer than timeout × (retries+1)
tasks.qa: Against a running server, call get_prompt('support') from a Python shell, check the compiled output, move the label in the UI, wait out the TTL, and check the new version arrives without a restart.

tasks.title: SDK linking and example app
tasks.description: Add prompt= to start_generation, update_current_observation and observe(as_type='generation'), and traceloom_prompt= to the OpenAI and Anthropic wrappers (stripped before the provider call). Fallback prompts are not linked, and linking never raises. Add examples/prompt_app.py, which fetches support from production, compiles it, and runs it through the fake LLM with linking.
acceptance: The stored generation has prompt_name and prompt_version set
A fallback prompt sets neither
traceloom_prompt is never passed to the provider SDK
Linking errors never propagate
tasks.qa: Run examples/prompt_app.py against the server, open the resulting trace, and check the generation shows prompt: support v2. Run again with the server prompt unreachable and check no link appears.

tasks.title: Seed Claude 5-family models, ADRs and README
tasks.description: Add the FR-X3 model entries (with the cache-write assumption noted in a comment) to seed/models.yaml. Write ADRs 0010, 0011 and 0012. Add a prompts and playground quickstart and the get_prompt snippet to the README. Propose the exact .env.example lines for the human in the change notes, since agents cannot edit that file.
acceptance: claude-sonnet-5-5 resolves to $2/$10 per million tokens via the cost engine
All FR-X3 models are present
The three ADRs exist and describe the decisions in the plan
The seed loads in the existing seed test
tasks.qa: Open Settings → Models in the browser and check the new Claude models and prices. Ingest a claude-sonnet-5-5 generation with usage and confirm a calculated cost.

stories.title: Signed, queued webhooks
stories.description: Queue message dispatch by type, shared crypto and SSRF guards, webhook configuration and delivery with retries and a delivery log, and the settings page.
acceptance: A label move delivers a signed webhook with retries
Private or loopback URLs are refused at save and at send
Secrets are encrypted at rest and shown once
Deliveries survive a restart in lite mode

tasks.title: Queue type dispatch registry
tasks.description: Messages gain a type discriminator (ingest by default when absent, and webhook_delivery). Both lite and Redis queues dispatch through a small registry, and the lite sweeper replays due webhook deliveries from the DB. Ingestion behaviour stays unchanged.
acceptance: Messages without a type are processed as ingest
A registered webhook_delivery handler is called for that type
The Phase 1 durability and ingestion tests stay green
tasks.qa: none

tasks.title: Crypto and SSRF guards
tasks.description: llm/crypto.py with MultiFernet encrypt/decrypt, rotation via comma-separated keys, and hint() giving …last4. llm/ssrf.py resolves, classifies and pins the IP, always blocks link-local and metadata addresses, and blocks private ones when the caller's policy says so. Both are shared by webhooks and LLM connections.
acceptance: Encrypt/decrypt round-trips and a rotated key still decrypts old data
Metadata and link-local addresses are always refused
Loopback and private addresses are refused unless allowed
A hostname resolving to a blocked IP is refused
The pinned IP is returned for use in the request
tasks.qa: none

tasks.title: Webhook service, signing and delivery worker
tasks.description: Configure, update and delete webhooks (encrypted secret, shown once), plus send-test. Deliver with JSON body and X-Traceloom-Signature t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, t.body), X-Traceloom-Delivery id, 10 s timeout, 5 attempts with exponential backoff and jitter on network, timeout and 5xx errors. Updates webhook_deliveries and runs the SSRF check at save and at every delivery. Audited.
acceptance: A receiver returning 500, 500, 200 gets success on attempt 3 with a valid signature and 3 attempts logged
A URL resolving to 127.0.0.1 is refused at save
Failed deliveries never block a label move
Pending deliveries are redelivered after a restart
The secret is not in the DB in plaintext
tasks.qa: none

tasks.title: Settings → Webhooks page
tasks.description: Admin-only settings tab with webhook list, add dialog (URL, events, secret shown once), enable/disable, deliveries table with status pills, attempts, response code and last error, and a Send test button.
acceptance: An Admin adds a webhook and sees the secret once
A Member gets 403 and no tab
Send test creates a delivery row visible in the table
A private URL shows an inline error
tasks.qa: As Admin, add a webhook pointing at a local receiver (with the private allowance enabled), click Send test, and watch the delivery succeed. Move a label and confirm a second delivery appears. Try http://127.0.0.1 with the allowance off and check the error.

stories.title: LLM connections and provider adapters
stories.description: A shared streaming adapter interface, six provider adapters tested on fake transports, and encrypted per-project connections with test-connection.
acceptance: Each of the six providers has an adapter that maps requests, streams deltas, extracts usage and scrubs errors
Connection secrets are encrypted and never read back
Test connection reports success or a scrubbed provider error

tasks.title: LLM connections service
tasks.description: CRUD for connections with Fernet-encrypted secrets, a …last4 hint, replace-but-never-read, custom models and headers, per-provider credential shapes, and the SSRF check on base URLs. Test-connection makes one minimal call and returns success or a scrubbed error. Listing for use by Members returns names and models only. Audited.

tasks.qa: none

acceptance: The Anthropic fake transport receives exactly the messages, model, temperature and tool of the source generation
